description:
Internal Sales Executive

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent (9 AM - 5 PM Monday to Friday)

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Internal Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, project coordination, and account management. You will play a key role in supporting customers, driving sales opportunities, coordinating projects, and ensuring a first-class customer experience throughout the sales process.

- Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries via phone and email, providing information on stock availability, product specifications, pricing, and order updates.

- Prepare and present sales and purchasing information in a clear and understandable format for both customers and internal stakeholders.
- Assist in the preparation of pricing proposals and quotations for new business opportunities.
- Support the external sales team by coordinating product demonstrations, equipment trials, and customer projects.
- Provide expert advice and guidance to customers on the most suitable products and services for their requirements.
- Recommend alternative products and solutions to meet customer specifications and project needs.
- Manage customer projects from enquiry through to completion, ensuring deadlines and expectations are met.

- Proactively follow up quotations and pricing opportunities to maximise sales conversion.

- Coordinate installations and specialist deliveries by liaising with logistics and service departments.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers through regular communication and account management.
- Attend customer meetings and support business development activities where required.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and customer service standards.
- Work collaboratively with departments including Sales, Accounts, Logistics, Service, and external manufacturers to ensure customer requirements are met.
- Develop and support new sales channels, including online marketplaces such as Amazon and other e-commerce platforms.

About You

We're looking for someone who brings:
- Experience in internal sales, sales support, customer service, account management, or a similar commercial role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational and project coordination abilities.
- The ability to multitask and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Confidence handling customer enquiries, quotations, and order processing.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
- Commercial awareness with the ability to identify sales opportunities and upselling potential.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and CRM systems.

The best route for most is moving into a Business Development Manager role, meaning you'll move into solely closing sales, getting you off the phones, going into a very senior position in the business, with the chance to earn up to 250 K per year.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Start date: 25.01.2027

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.
